map.聚焦高斯光束腰斑 使用指南: Focused Gaussian Beam Waist User Guide
map.聚焦高斯光束腰斑计算器由入射光斑、波长与聚焦透镜求束腰半径，适合激光加工、光通信: The focused Gaussian beam waist calculator finds the waist radius from the input spot, wavelength and focusing lens, for estimating focal spot size in laser processing, optical communication and optics experiments.
map.由波长与束腰算远场发散与腰斑。: Far-field divergence and waist spot from wavelength and beam waist.
map.M² 因子修正实际光束。: The M^2 factor corrects a real beam.
map.：1064nm 激光束腰 w0=1mm → 远场半角 θ=λ/(πw0)=1.0: : A 1064 nm laser with waist w0 = 1 mm gives a far-field half-angle theta = lambda/(pi*w0) = 1.064e-3/(pi x 1), about 0.339 mrad; at a distance of 1 m the spot radius is about 0.34 mm.
map.：同束经 f=50mm 透镜聚焦，焦点腰 w0'≈λf/(πw)=1.064e-: : The same beam focused by an f = 50 mm lens gives a focal waist w0' about lambda*f/(pi*w) = 1.064e-3 x 50/(pi x 1), about 16.9 um, for precision micro-machining.
map.受衍射极限，波长越短、入射腰越大聚焦越小；M²>1 的实际光束比理想大 M² 倍: Limited by diffraction, the shorter the wavelength and the larger the input waist the smaller the focus; a real beam with M^2 > 1 is M^2 times larger than ideal.
map.θ=λ/(πw0)，腰越小发散越大，准直需大腰或长焦距扩束。: theta = lambda/(pi*w0); the smaller the waist the larger the divergence, so collimation needs a large waist or a long focal length expander.
